narrative.overview:
Hearing Assist is a white, quiet page where the loudest thing is what was said. Captions and notes are the hero; everything else steps back. Two self-hosted faces carry it: Bricolage Grotesque for a warm, confident display voice and Atkinson Hyperlegible Next, drawn by the Braille Institute for low-vision readers, for everything read and operated.

The one indulgence is the aura: a soft green and blue light behind the places where words appear (the landing stage, the caption preview, the Home start card, live captions, the closing band). Color otherwise has jobs: green acts, blue marks AI and sources, red is only the microphone and deleting, and each note mode owns one quiet hue for its badge and icon.

Accessibility is the brand, not a setting: AA contrast in light, dark and Increase Contrast, 44 px targets, focus rings on everything reachable, reflow at 320 px with 200% text, and state never shown by color alone.
keyCharacteristics: Words that settle (420 ms blur to sharp)
Bricolage display, Atkinson Hyperlegible Next body
Flat cards with 1px edges; shadows only on floating chrome

rules.name: The Aura Rule
rules.body: The aura sits only behind captions, the caption preview, the Home start card and the landing hero and closing band, at 0.4 opacity (0.32 dark). Never behind paragraphs; hidden under Increase Contrast and Reduce Transparency.

rules.name: The Jobs Rule
rules.body: Green does things, blue is AI and sources, red is only the microphone and deleting, mode hues only say which mode.

rules.name: The Flat-Edge Rule
rules.body: Cards are flat with a 1px line. Shadows belong to floating chrome. No thick accent stripes on rounded cards.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Bricolage for display and headings; Atkinson Hyperlegible Next for everything read or tapped. Sizes in rem so they follow the phone's text size.

dos: Do let real words be the hero: captions, notes, example content labeled as examples.
Do keep one primary action per view.
Do show selection with a check or text, not color alone.
Do keep tap targets at 44 px or more.
donts: Don't add eyebrow labels, gradient text, glass cards or three equal feature cards.
Don't use red for anything but the microphone and deleting.
Don't put thick accent stripes on rounded cards.
Don't invent claims: no user counts, accuracy percentages or testimonials.
